items.title: 2.6.3.3 Indexing and Slicing with Negative Indices (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of negative indices (PDF 53-54).

blocks.text: Negative index (minus wala index) sequence ke aakhir se ginta hai: -1 aakhri item, -2 aakhri se pehla, waghera.
Misaal: list par positive aur negative dono indexes se indexing aur slicing.

#    Create a list of fruits
fruits = ["Apple", "Banana", "Cherry", "Date", "Elderberry " ]
#    Indexing
print("First fruit:", fruits [0])    # Positive index
print("Last fruit:", fruits [-1])   # Negative index
#    Slicing with positive indices
print("Fruits from index 1 to 3:", fruits[1:4])
#    Slicing with negative indices
print("Fruits from index -4 to -1:", fruits [-4 : - 1] )

First fruit: Apple
Last fruit: Elderberry
Fruits from index 1 to 3: ['Banana', 'Cherry', 'Date']
Fruits from index -4 to -1: ['Banana', 'Cherry', 'Date']
blocks.caption: Output (program chalane par)

blocks.text: Wazahat: code fruits ki list banata hai, positive aur negative index se items nikalta hai, aur dono tarah slicing karta hai. fruits[1:4] aur fruits[-4:-1] ek hi items dete hain. ("Elderberry " ke aakhir mein space kitab ke mutabiq hai; is se sirf print mein ek khaali jagah aati hai.)

blocks.alt: Fruits list ke paanch khaane: Apple, Banana, Cherry, Date, Elderberry. Oopar positive index 0 se 4, neeche negative index -5 se -1. Banana, Cherry aur Date ke neeche ek bracket ke saath likha hai fruits[1:4] = fruits[-4:-1].
blocks.caption: Positive aur negative index: dono tareeqon se ek hi cheezein milti hain (asal khaaka; kitab mein figure nahi).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text:
Yeh list, tuple aur string lein:
List: [10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80]
Tuple: ("Math", "Science", "English", "History", "Geography")
String: "Python Programming"
Yeh kaam karein:
1. Har sequence ka teesra item print karein.
2. List aur tuple se index 2 se 5 tak slice print karein.
3. String ka index 7 se aakhir tak hissa print karein.
4. Negative index se list aur tuple ke aakhri do items print karein.
5. Negative slicing se string ke aakhri se pehle wale character se aakhir tak print karein.
In kaamon ka Python code likh kar results print karein.

blocks.prompt: Class activity ke jawab kya hain?
blocks.explanation: 1. L[2] = 30, T[2] = 'English', s[2] = 't'. 2. L[2:6] = [30, 40, 50, 60], T[2:6] = ('English', 'History', 'Geography') (index 2 se 5, dono shamil). 3. s[7:] = 'Programming'. 4. L[-2:] = [70, 80], T[-2:] = ('History', 'Geography'). 5. s[-2:] = 'ng'.

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Indexing aur slicing sequences ke saath kaam ke powerful (taqatwar) tools hain. In ki practice (mashq) karein ta ke data ke khaas hisse aasani se nikal sakein aur data par kaam mein maharat aaye.

items: -1 aakhri item; fruits[-4:-1] = fruits[1:4] (paanch items wali list mein).
